Competition Format

Team Formation Rules
1. Each team must have at least 5 members, including the captain, to be successfully formed and participate in the competition.
2. Teams with fewer than 5 members before the competition begins will be automatically disbanded, and their members will be reassigned to other teams by the system.
3. Users who register during the competition must manually select a team by 15:59 (UTC) on the day of registration. Otherwise, the system will randomly assign them to a team.
Team Types
1. Open Team: Any user can join freely.
2. Private Team: Users must enter the password set by the captain to join.
3. Once a team is successfully formed, the captain cannot disband the team, and members cannot leave.
